other_conditions: Student must be the child of a beneficiary under the KALIA scheme (Support to Cultivators or Livelihood Support to Landless Agricultural Households)
Parent must be verified as eligible under KALIA at the Chief District Agriculture Officer (CDAO) level
Student must obtain admission in a Government institution of Odisha on a merit basis
Only one scholarship per student is allowed; the student must not be receiving any other scholarship simultaneously
Scholarship can be availed for only one professional/technical course
Only verified online applications are considered; physical applications are not accepted
benefits_summary: Tuition, annual, hostel and other fees are paid directly to the student via DBT, along with monthly hostel mess allowances of ₹1200 for degree courses and ₹1000 for diploma/ITI courses.
